what: Several full-bleed photo panels overlap on one screen (each panel height = number of panels × 100vh), each scroll share peels the top panel away upward from the bottom with clip-path, revealing the panel below. The revealed panel starts 50% dark and brightens as it is peeled, and the center progress ring (if any) fills in equal parts per panel. A numbered vertical banner section

options.dark: Initial darkness of the revealed panel (0 to 1), default .5 — 0 means no darkening
options.scrub: Lag following the scroll (seconds), default immediate (true)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Stacked panels (at least two) — the earlier one sits on top
options.[data-fx-part=shade]: (If present) dark overlay inside the panel — if absent, no darkening
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: (if any) progress ring — pathLength="1" In svg circle(stroke-dasharray 1)

note: Pinning is sticky, so it does not break even inside an inner scroll panel. Section height is set by part count × 100vh (kept as is if the user already gave a height). [data-fx-part=The screen with view] attached — first child if none
